step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Splunk Cloud's data ingestion and multi-tiered storage architecture. On the left ('CUSTOMER' side), data originates from external sources (DATA icon), AWS Lambda, and Kinesis Data Firehose, with a customer-owned S3 bucket at the bottom. On the right ('SPLUNK' side), ingestion occurs through two Elastic Load Balancers (ELB) - one for HTTP Event Collector (HEC) data and another for Kinesis Data Firehose. These feed into EC2 instances acting as Splunk indexers/cache tier. From EC2, data is offloaded to an S3 bucket for active Splunk storage and an S3 Glacier tier for long-term archiving. Data from Splunk S3 can also be exported back to the Customer's S3 bucket.
